Welcome, coaches, to our next presentation. Emma Doyle is a performance coach and international speaker, helping you turn your motivation into activation. She has been coaching for 30 years and through her keynote speaking, mentoring, coaching, and consultancy, she inspires, improves, and impacts players, coaches, teams, and corporates within her global triangle of Melbourne, Australia, Denver, Colorado, and Glasgow in Scotland. Today, she's here to share her journey and we welcome her back. Emma, over to you. G'day, everybody, and thank you so much to Tennis Australia and all the team for allowing me to be a part of the 2022 Virtual Grand Slam Coaches Conference. I miss Australia, I miss Melbourne very much. It's been a couple of years now since I've been home because of the global pandemic, but I feel very connected to all my coaches. I miss everybody and I know that we're all united because of Tennis and this great sport. And so when I was asked to present, I was speaking with Nicole Pratt and she suggested that I share my coaching journey. I'm always talking about different topics to do with coaching and technical, tactical. And she said that it might be just a nice idea to share a little bit of my background, which I feel is something that I'm just a girl from East Kielor that's grown up and didn't play tennis at a high level, but have been able to maximize my experience of coaching
